disease.title: Plant Disease Diagnosis & Crop Protection
disease.subtitle: Upload or capture a leaf photo for AI diagnosis, quality checking, and organic IPM recommendations.
disease.supported_crops_desc: The pretrained computer vision model classifies foliar lesions across 14 crops. For crops outside this benchmark, visual similarity matches are returned with a clear mismatch notice.
disease.drag_drop_text: Drag and drop leaf photo here, or browse from device
disease.select_farm_label: Select Farm (Optional, for microclimate fungal risk)
disease.opt_in_outbreak_label: Contribute anonymized village report to Community Outbreak Map
disease.opt_in_outbreak_hint: Privacy guaranteed: Uploaded leaf photo is never stored. Only village centroid and detected disease are shared.
disease.ipm_disclaimer: Strict safety guideline: Cultural and organic steps only. Zero specific chemical dosages are provided without direct qualified agronomist consultation.
disease.uncertain_warning: Diagnosis is inconclusive due to low prediction confidence. Please consult your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Agriculture Officer before applying any treatment.
disease.no_history: No previous disease reports submitted yet.
disease.ready_desc: Upload or capture an affected plant leaf. Our on-device vision agent will evaluate photo sharpness, classify foliar symptoms, and recommend organic IPM controls.
disease.photo_tips_title: Tips for capturing a diagnostic leaf photo:
disease.photo_tip_1: Hold the camera steady 15–20 cm away from the affected foliar lesion.
disease.photo_tip_2: Ensure soft, even daylight without severe harsh shadows or direct flash glare.
disease.photo_tip_3: Frame a single symptomatic leaf against a natural or neutral background.
disease.indicative_microclimate: Indicative microclimate assessment based on open agro-meteorological data.
disease.speech_not_supported: Speech synthesis is not supported in this browser.
disease.no_voice_for_language: No speech synthesis voice found on your device for {lang}. Audio cannot be played.
disease.visual_indication_only: Visual indication only, not a soil moisture measurement. Please confirm to proceed.
disease.non_agri_detected: Non-agricultural photo detected. No diagnosis generated.
disease.plain_meaning_default: Upload or capture a sharp photo of an affected leaf to identify symptoms and safe cultural treatments.

irrigation.title: FAO-56 Irrigation Water Budget & Field Diagnostics
irrigation.subtitle: Single crop coefficient water balance, rain-skip conservation, and in-field problem diagnosis.
irrigation.modelled_not_measured: Soil moisture is modelled, not measured. Confirm with physical inspection before pumping.
irrigation.empty_plan_desc: Configure your farm and crop parameters above and click 'Compute Crop Water Budget' to evaluate FAO-56 balance.
irrigation.error_plan_desc: Unable to calculate FAO-56 balance. Check network connection or verify farm details.
irrigation.litres_saved_desc: Forecasted rainfall satisfies crop evapotranspiration, eliminating unnecessary pump runtime.
irrigation.water_balance_heading: 7-Day Root Zone Water Balance (Rain vs ETc)
irrigation.suitability_title: Should I Grow This Crop Now? (Water Availability Assessment)
irrigation.suitability_desc: Evaluates crop seasonal water demand against local rainfall and available irrigation infrastructure.
irrigation.diagnose_subtitle: Describe field issues in English, Telugu, or Hindi, or attach an in-field photo for instant evaluation.
irrigation.issue_input_placeholder: Describe what is happening (e.g. water is stagnating after rain, leaves drooping in the afternoon, white salt crust on soil, clogged drippers)...
irrigation.visual_disclaimer: Visual indication only, not a soil moisture measurement.
irrigation.finger_test_notice: Do not rely on photos alone to measure moisture. Confirm soil root-zone moisture with this direct physical method before activating pumps:
irrigation.chart_subtitle: Blue bars show rain, green line shows root zone depletion, red dashed line shows RAW stress limit.
irrigation.diagnostic_desc: Describe foliar wilting, leaf tip burns, or upload a field photo to diagnose waterlogging or salinity issues.
irrigation.describe_symptoms_label: Describe Visible Water or Soil Symptoms
irrigation.run_budget_prompt: Run crop water budget to display 7-day balance chart.
irrigation.fao_scientific_note: Scientific basis: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 56. When root zone depletion exceeds RAW, the crop experiences moisture stress and evapotranspiration drops below maximum potential ETc.

howto.video_fallback_desc: Video coming soon. Please follow the written steps below.
howto.step1_desc: Select your preferred language (English, Telugu, Hindi) and verify your registered farm holding in the banner.
howto.step2_desc: Check whether rainfall is expected today. High rainfall forecasts trigger rain-skips to save pump electricity.
howto.step3_desc: Compute water budget to see root-zone moisture depletion and required irrigation depth in millimetres and litres.
howto.step4_desc: Upload a leaf photo. AI models identify leaf spots or blight with confidence percentage and IPM treatments.
howto.step5_desc: Adjust expected yield and mandi market price sliders to see live impact on net profit and operational margins.
howto.step6_desc: Speak naturally with voice assistant in Telugu, Hindi or English for instant answers linked to the exact screens.
howto.video_not_supported: Your browser does not support HTML5 video.

tour.step1_desc: Switch between English, Telugu (తెలుగు), and Hindi (हिन्दी) anytime from the top bar. All recommendations and audio read-aloud support your local language.
tour.step2_title: Step 2: Choose or Add Your Farm Parcel
tour.step2_desc: Select your active farm parcel or add a new one. Enter whether land is owned or leased so irrigation and profit models reflect your true costs.
tour.step3_desc: View live weather conditions and rainfall forecasts calibrated to your village. See daily reference evapotranspiration (ET0) for crop water demand.
tour.step4_title: Step 4: Crop Water Budget & Irrigation Advice
tour.step4_desc: Know exactly when and how much to water your field using FAO-56 agro-meteorological models. Avoid water wastage and protect root zones.
tour.step5_title: Step 5: Scan Crop Leaf for Disease Diagnosis
tour.step5_desc: Upload or take a photo of a crop leaf to identify diseases with confidence ratings, symptoms, and organic or chemical treatment advice.
tour.step6_title: Step 6: Understand Farm Costs & Live Profit
tour.step6_desc: Calculate operating expenses, compare crops, and use the interactive What-If slider to estimate your net profit under changing yields and mandi prices.
tour.step7_title: Step 7: Ask the Voice Assistant Anytime
tour.step7_desc: Tap the Voice button to speak in Telugu, Hindi, or English. Ask questions like "Will it rain today?", "Should I irrigate?", or "What is the mandi price?".
